17	def insert(connection, record):
18	    values = {key: value for key, value in asdict(record).items() if value is not None}
19	    columns = ", ".join(values)
20	    marks = ", ".join("?" for _ in values)
21	    cursor = connection.execute(f"INSERT INTO {MODELS[type(record)]} ({columns}) VALUES ({marks})", list(values.values()))
22	    connection.commit()

27	    row = connection.execute(f"SELECT * FROM {MODELS[model]} WHERE id = ?", (record_id,)).fetchone()
28	    if row is None:

30	    return model(**{field.name: row[field.name] for field in fields(model)})

36	    connection.execute(f"UPDATE {MODELS[type(record)]} SET {assignments} WHERE id = ?", [*values.values(), record.id])

3	import hashlib
4	from pathlib import Path
5	
6	import yaml
7	
8	ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
9	SCHEMA = ROOT / "schema" / "models.yaml"
10	TYPES = {"int": "int", "str": "str", "bool": "bool", "float": "float"}
11	SQL = {"int": "INTEGER", "str": "TEXT", "bool": "INTEGER", "float": "REAL"}
12	
13	
14	def load():
15	    models = yaml.safe_load(SCHEMA.read_text())["models"]
16	    for name, model in models.items():
17	        for field, spec in model["fields"].items():
18	            if spec.get("type") not in TYPES:
19	                raise SystemExit(f"schema: {name}.{field} has unsupported type {spec.get('type')!r}")
20	    return models
21	
22	
23	def digest():
24	    return hashlib.sha256(SCHEMA.read_bytes()).hexdigest()[:12]
25	
26	
27	def python_default(spec):
28	    if "default" not in spec:
29	        return "None" if not spec.get("primary") else None
30	    return repr(spec["default"])
31	
32	
33	def render_models(models):
34	    lines = [f"# GENERATED by `make generate` from schema/models.yaml (schema {digest()}). Do not edit.", ""]
35	    lines += ["from dataclasses import dataclass", "", f'SCHEMA_DIGEST = "{digest()}"', ""]
36	    for name, model in models.items():
37	        lines += ["", "@dataclass", f"class {name}:"]
38	        required = [(f, s) for f, s in model["fields"].items() if s.get("primary")]
39	        optional = [(f, s) for f, s in model["fields"].items() if not s.get("primary")]
40	        for field, spec in required:
41	            lines.append(f"    {field}: {TYPES[spec['type']]}")
42	        for field, spec in optional:
43	            lines.append(f"    {field}: {TYPES[spec['type']]} | None = {python_default(spec)}")
44	        lines.append("")
45	    lines += ["", "TABLES = {" + ", ".join(f'"{m["table"]}": {n}' for n, m in models.items()) + "}", ""]
46	    return "\n".join(lines)

56	    lines += ['        raise ValueError(f"{model} has no field(s): {sorted(unknown)}")', "    return values", ""]
